usedFor: Teams use Agent AI to pull page text with “Web Page Content” and company details with “Enrich Company Data”.

bestTemplate.name: “Record Created Or Updated” in Airtable, then “Enrich Company Data” in Agent AI
bestTemplate.why: Each changed record gets fuller company details, so nobody researches the row by hand.

watchOut: “YouTube Video Transcript” needs the video URL, and AI agents run on a schedule or when you ask them.
